plate_comment: Initializes the P1740 converter clutch / overdrive rationality monitor: converter_clutch_rationality_last_throttle = 0xffff (no throttle sample yet) (was initProtectionOutputFlags)

Runs the SCI actuator tests while any is active: The SCI command 0x13 actuator tests (DRB 'actuator test' codes, names from the DRB database mydb: 13-09 A/C clutch relay, 13-0C cruise vacuum + vent, 13-0F torque converter clutch, 13-16 overdrive solenoid, 13-1A / 13-1B cruise vent / vacuum, 13-28 / 13-29 intake heater 1 / 2, 13-2C cruise 12 volt feed, 13-33 fuel transfer pump, 13-43 transmission relay, 13-49 wait to start lamp, 13-5D exhaust brake, 13-5E fuel control, 13-5F PWM radiator fan). With the engine stopped, every 141 passes it flips sci_output_test_drive_phase_flag and steps each test timer (cm848_stepSciOutputTest) and the 13-5E / 13-5F countdowns; once the engine runs it stops every test (cm848_stopAllSciOutputTests). When none is left it clears the transmission actuator test flag (actuator_test_flags bit 0) (was engine_coldStart_protectionSequence_update)

One phase step of one SCI actuator test (timer pointer, logical output): decrements the timer; at 0 the test ends (sci_output_test_active_count - 1, the output request at priority 5 is cleared and the priority released), otherwise the output is driven on or off by sci_output_test_drive_phase_flag (was diag_protection_countdown_trigger)

Stops one running SCI actuator test (timer pointer, logical output): sci_output_test_active_count - 1, clears the output request at priority 5, releases the priority and zeroes the timer (was diag_protection_event_clear)

Stops every SCI actuator test: cm848_stopSciOutputTest for the 12 output tests, then the 13-5E fuel control and 13-5F radiator fan tests (their flags and countdowns) (was diag_protection_fault_init_all)
